title: Flying mounts: horse, baby dragon, ghast
desc: The horse is the flying construct; a rideable baby dragon; a construct ghast sized to fit over the real ghast model.

takes.name: flying horse
takes.facts: gallops then runs up into the air to 9 blocks; light pads under the hooves

takes.name: baby dragon
takes.facts: chubby, stubby fast wings; hop, climb to 7, glide 70-90, bank 28 deg

takes.name: ghast, real size
takes.facts: 4x4x4 body over the real model, 9 tentacles; rises 3.5 and drifts

takes.name: ghast, harnessed
takes.facts: same size, harness with 4 seats and goggles; rises with 4 riders
